title: Projek Akhir / Persediaan SKBMW
canDo: Produce an extended piece of writing across a topic of choice
Deliver an extended, structured oral presentation with Q&A
Complete a full mock assessment across listening, reading, writing, and speaking
Reflect on overall progress from A1 to C1
lifeBenefit: Consolidate everything learned and prepare directly for the SKBMW's four-skill assessment format.

vocab.example: Saya sediakan portfolio pembelajaran sepanjang kursus ini.
vocab.exampleEn: I've prepared a learning portfolio throughout this course.

vocab.example: Penilaian kendiri membantu saya kenal pasti kelemahan.
Selepas pembentangan, ada sesi soal jawab.
vocab.exampleEn: After the presentation, there's a Q&A session.

vocab.example: Matlamat saya mencapai kecekapan tahap C1.
vocab.exampleEn: My goal is to achieve C1-level proficiency.

vocab.example: Saya akan duduk peperiksaan untuk dapatkan sijil kecekapan.
vocab.exampleEn: I will sit the exam to get the competency certificate.

vocab.example: Persediaan peperiksaan perlu bermula lebih awal.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'This portfolio includes a self-assessment of my progress from A1 to C1.'
practiceExercises.answer: Portfolio ini termasuk penilaian kendiri kemajuan saya dari A1 ke C1.

practiceExercises.prompt: Translate: 'My goal is to achieve C1 proficiency and handle the Q&A session confidently.'
practiceExercises.answer: Matlamat saya mencapai kecekapan C1 dan mengendalikan sesi soal jawab dengan yakin.

practiceExercises.prompt: 'Saya akan duduk peperiksaan untuk dapatkan ___.' (competency certificate)
This lesson runs a full mock assessment covering listening, reading, writing, and speaking, structured to mirror the SKBMW format (Writing 600/1, Reading 600/2, Listening 600/3, Speaking 600/4).

scenario.setting: A mock SKBMW-style oral examination with an examiner

script.ms: Selamat datang. Sila perkenalkan diri dan bincangkan satu isu semasa pilihan awak.
script.en: Welcome. Please introduce yourself and discuss a current issue of your choice.

script.ms: Terima kasih. Nama saya... dan saya ingin bincangkan isu kos sara hidup.
script.en: Thank you. My name is... and I would like to discuss the cost of living issue.

script.ms: Menarik. Apa pandangan awak tentang langkah kerajaan setakat ini?
script.en: Interesting. What's your view on the government's measures so far?

script.ms: Pada hemat saya, langkah ini membantu, tapi walau bagaimanapun, kesannya jangka pendek sahaja.
script.en: In my opinion, these measures help, but however, the effect is only short-term.

script.ms: Terima kasih atas pandangan yang seimbang. Ada sesi soal jawab sekarang.
script.en: Thank you for the balanced view. There's a Q&A session now.

scenario.aiPrompt: You are an SKBMW-style oral examiner. Ask the candidate to introduce themselves and discuss a current issue, probe their opinion with a follow-up question, and acknowledge strong, balanced responses. Formal, standard assessment register, encouraging but rigorous.

speakingPrompts.instructions: Shadow the full mock oral exam dialogue, matching formal assessment register and pacing.
Sit a full mock oral exam with the AI examiner persona: introduce yourself, discuss a current issue, and handle a follow-up question.
rubric: discusses an issue with a clear, balanced opinion

speakingPrompts.instructions: Deliver a 5-minute capstone presentation: your Bahasa Malaysia learning journey from A1 to C1, a topic of personal interest discussed in depth, and your goals going forward.
rubric: covers learning journey, topic discussion, and future goals
demonstrates C1-level range: connectors, register-shifting, nuanced argument, proverbs or idioms if natural

questions.prompt: Translate: 'My goal is to achieve C1-level proficiency.'
questions.answer: Matlamat saya mencapai kecekapan tahap C1.
